title: Changelog
text: Add shennong.dev/data-bundle/v1 client materialization contract long, wide, dense, sparse, SummarizedExperiment, Seurat outputs, explicit completeness, axis, missing-feature, zero-semantics provenance. Add optional governed Project scope sn_connect(project_id = ...), -origin X-Shennong-Project-Id, query-body bridging, MCP SHENNONG_PROJECT_ID configuration. Export documented sn_resolve_features(), sn_slice_head(), sn_write_query() helpers. Add R-native read-MCP stdio server six bounded Agent tools compatibility checks, Resource discovery/inspection, identifier resolution, query planning, small provenance-aware fetches. Add repository-local shennong-data Agent Skill, MCP installation guide, Resource discovery API, programmatic API compatibility report. Typed serializable query plans, strict filter/select pushdown, feature resolution, bounded multi-feature fetch, provenance-aware results. Artifact listing/download verification, conversion planning, biological object adapters, relation/collection helpers, server capability flags. Align gene resolution server GET contract, use Artifact-ID download routes, consume cursor pages, expose Arrow/JSONL streaming hooks.

title: Changelog
text: Fetch declared observation axes matrix/sparse materialization, build sparse matrices directly, remove explicit zero entries, reject sparse output missing coordinates declared structural zeroes. Restrict Artifact credentials connection origin, strip bearer Project headers foreign presigned redirects, require foreign HTTPS, make local file access explicit root-confined trusted mode. Require complete DataBundles analysis-container conversion default; retain allow_partial = TRUE explicit provenance-reviewed escape hatch. Document production use Shennong OS/gateway user PAT, never DB admin key, correct TOIL layer log2_tpm_plus_0.001. Fall back gateway-level /version 404/405 /api/v1/public-config retaining strict ShennongDB API-v1 negotiation. Refresh contract matrix frozen server version ShennongDB 1.0.0 contract exposed Shennong OS/gateway, without making live-deployment claim. Expose metadata-first query, artifact, conversion, collection APIs preserving existing Resource handle contract.

title: Changelog

title: Data materialization contracts
text: Every materialized result records target contract shennong.dev/data-bundle/v1. mean every current ShennongDB Resource already emits complete DataBundle: status = "resource_declared" means Resource metadata declared schema_version = "shennong.dev/data-bundle/v1"; status = "client_projection" means ShennongData projected current Resource/query response target contract; complete, axis_complete, missing_features, incomplete_reasons describe whether projection safe consume complete matrix. analysis package uses different output contract, shennong.dev/analysis-result-bundle/v1. ShennongData produces input data provenance; public Shennong analysis function produces validates analysis result.
code: result <- sn_fetch_data(   x,   features = c("YTHDF2", "FTO"),   layer = "log2_tpm_plus_0.001",   shape = "long",   limit = 100 )  sn_result_schema(result) sn_provenance(result)$data_bundle sn_is_partial(result)

title: Data materialization contracts
text: four shapes explicit contracts: matrix sparse requests, client fetches complete observation axis server advertises axis endpoint. Without complete axis, -zero observations recovered, result marked partial. Batch missing_features metadata also retained incomplete provenance. Explicit zero entries removed sparse matrix Matrix::drop0().

title: Data materialization contracts
text: sn_as() supports explicit matrix sparse targets preserves provenance SummarizedExperiment metadata Seurat misc. Analysis containers reject partial inputs default. allow_partial = TRUE escape hatch user reviewed incomplete reasons; completeness assertion. current TOIL layer exactly log2_tpm_plus_0.001. transformed expression, raw counts, suitable bulk QC DESeq2/edgeR count workflows:
code: se <- sn_as(   x,   "SummarizedExperiment",   features = c("YTHDF2", "FTO"),   layer = "log2_tpm_plus_0.001" )  S4Vectors::metadata(se)$shennong$data_bundle bulk_qc <- Shennong::sn_run_bulk(se, workflow = "qc") Shennong::sn_validate_result(bulk_qc, error = FALSE)$valid

title: Data materialization contracts
text: -origin Artifact endpoints may receive connection bearer token. foreign presigned URL never receives , must use HTTPS, followed bounded, manually reconstructed redirects. Automatic credential forwarding disabled. Local paths file:// URIs ignored default. Trusted-local access requires trusted_local = TRUE local_root; normalized paths symlink targets must remain root.

title: ShennongData 0.2.0.9000
text: Materialized results now target shennong.dev/data-bundle/v1 explicit client-projection, completeness, axis, missing-feature, orientation, structural-zero provenance. sn_connect(project_id = ...) supports governed Shennong OS/gateway access user PAT. Project scope added authenticated -origin requests query bodies; foreign Artifact redirects receive neither bearer Project headers. Sparse output now requires implicit_zero = TRUE, retrieves declared observation axes available, uses direct sparse construction, drops explicit zero entries. Local Artifact paths require explicit trusted-local mode confinement configured root. SummarizedExperiment Seurat conversions preserve DataBundle provenance reject partial inputs default. sn_resolve_features(), sn_slice_head(), sn_write_query() now exported documented.
